entries.text: 就是啊，\n我太难了……[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_01

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]！好久不见！\n你是不是想死我了！？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_02

entries.text: 嘻嘻……\n真是个直率的好孩子！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_03

entries.text: 什么嘛！太久没见，\n你失忆了？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_04

entries.text: 很高兴见到你，\n再见。[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_steelbb_04

entries.text: 那孩子是我的同班同学，\n是个超～有趣的女生。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_06

entries.text: 在蓝莓见到[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你，\n总觉得好神奇啊。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_08

entries.text: 仔细一瞧，你啊……\n真是一点都没变呢！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_09

entries.text: 是因为我最近\n和白蕾雅老师一起\r\n去了很多地区做调查吗？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_10

entries.text: 所以我的宝可梦对战\n比之前和你交手时变得更强了哦～[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_11

entries.text: 嘻嘻，你一定很想见识一下吧？\c\n这里刚好有对战场，\n来各就各位吧。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_12

entries.text: 我们来双打对战！\n做好心理准备了吗？\r\n我会让你惊掉下巴哦。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_13

entries.text: 啊～！\n我明明靠太晶化变强了！\r\n可你比我变强了更多！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_14

entries.text: 你毫不留情的风格\n和之前一模一样呢！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_15

entries.text: 对了，话说回来，\n你和阿栗……见面了吗？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_16

entries.text: 没有！
entries.label: sdc02_0088_select_01

entries.text: 发生什么事了？
entries.label: sdc02_0088_select_02

entries.text: 啊，没事……\n还没见就好。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_17

entries.text: 你怎么连这都做不到！！[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_brother_01

entries.text: 果然是乌栗，\n他离我们贼近……[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_27

entries.text: 乌栗！？
entries.label: sdc02_0088_select_05

entries.text: 他变了个人！？
entries.label: sdc02_0088_select_06

entries.text: 我说过至少要培养\n５只比赛用的宝可梦吧？[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_brother_02

entries.text: 抱、抱歉，\n这个月家里有事要忙……
entries.label: sdc02_0088_mob_01

entries.text: 那你就弱一辈子好了，\n怎么样？[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_brother_04

entries.text: 不、不是……
entries.label: sdc02_0088_mob_02

entries.text: 你好像很忙，\n那我替你写了吧。[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_brother_05

entries.text: 我的社团不需要\n拿不出全力的家伙。[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_brother_07

entries.text: 等一下！乌栗！\n原谅我吧！拜托了！
entries.label: sdc02_0088_mob_03

entries.text:
阿栗他的外表和性格
都有点……变了，
大概是夏令营结束以后吧，
从那时候开始就……[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_30

entries.text: 总觉得～\n眼前发生的事让人很不爽啊。[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_01

entries.text: 哎呀呀？是丹瑜……\n还有一位我没见过的。\r\n……该不会就是[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]他她吧？[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_02

entries.text: 之前提过的那个问题人物。[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_03

entries.text: 啧！\n被烦人的家伙发现了。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_18

entries.text: 喂喂，\n好歹介绍一下啊。[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_04

entries.text: ……这人是杜若，\n是个讨厌的男生。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_19

entries.text: 算是蓝莓学园\n最强的家伙……曾经是。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_20

entries.text: 多谢你的介绍～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_05

entries.text: 这位是[VAR 0x0100(0000)]，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]他她是来交换留学的，\r\n是我的朋友……[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_21

entries.text: 你和乌栗！\n也是朋友吧～？[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_06

entries.text: 是的
entries.label: sdc02_0088_select_03

entries.text: 是朋友
entries.label: sdc02_0088_select_04

entries.text: 哦～\n果然是这样啊！\r\n那真是太好了～！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_07

entries.text: 那好～[VAR 0x0100(0000)]！\n带你参观一下我们的社团活动室吧～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_08

entries.text: 你还没参加社团吧？[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_09

entries.text: 加入社团的话，\n学园生活也会过得更顺。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_10

entries.text: 我们就希望有趣的家伙能来！\n……得先下手为强啊～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_11

entries.text: 这家伙真会耍人玩，气死我了～！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_24
